primitive-budget.name: Primitive Budget
primitive-budget.description: Web application for managing and controlling personal budgets graphically. With the ability to export information and share it through JSON files.

devforce-2024.name: DevForce 2024
devforce-2024.description: Udemy license management frontend for a company. Educational project for a web development course called DevForce for high school graduates.
